scope.cleanup: Always attempt exact-key DELETE in a finally path after every authenticated PUT call, including malformed timing and ambiguous responses; delete an unexpectedly accepted unauthenticated control with the valid staging token
scope.required_result: every authenticated PUT -> 200 and every cleanup DELETE -> 204
forbidden_shortcuts: auth refusal counted as a PUT
retryable response hidden or retried silently
missing Server-Timing phase treated as zero

attribution.hashing: the current container has no separate hash phase; BLAKE3 body hashing remains inside ohandler and is named in the artifact metadata
attribution.storage: ostore and oaccounting are required separately so R2 latency cannot be hidden inside D1 accounting
attribution.cold_warm: auth desc=d1 is cold; auth desc=l1 or kv is warm; both populations are required
attribution.budget: ohop + named origin sub-phases == origin within 1 ms of wire rounding

retry_contract.action: retain status, Retry-After, and timing, then fail the lane

closure.target: hot PUT server path returns to the owner-declared order of 30-50 ms
required_receipt: p50 and p90 for total and every named phase
phase-level comparison against the prior receipt
closure.current_blocker: no staging receipt has been captured by this repository-only change

prohibited: PAT or tenant secret values in artifacts
